title: SRF instrument catalog
description: Schema for data/regulations.json. source_kind separates binding instruments and voluntary standards, which can be obligations, from catalogs, which are not.

source_kind.description: binding and voluntary_standard can be obligations. catalog is a risk list, threat list, or control catalog and is not an obligation.

source_kind_note.description: Why this source_kind was chosen when the record's tags do not say it outright. Bill can change the kind.

current_obligation.description: Optional override. When set, it wins over the draft, rescinded, and proposed-tag rule.
